purpose: Test whether a fixed intraday relative-spread state has repeatable development-only association with subsequent 30-minute realized price movement, without defining or evaluating a trading strategy.

state_definition.baseline_window: 10:30 through 11:25 UTC inclusive, exactly 12 immediately preceding contiguous M5 observations
requirements: all 13 observations from 10:30 through 11:30 UTC must be present, complete, unique, ordered, and contiguous on the M5 grid
all prices and spreads must be positive finite numbers
baseline median relative spread must be positive

forward_response.window: 11:35 through 12:00 UTC inclusive, exactly 6 subsequent contiguous M5 observations
forward_response.gap_policy: if any required future observation is missing or non-contiguous, the observation day is structurally ineligible; no interpolation or synthetic bar is permitted

analysis.primary_association: Spearman rank correlation between spread_state_ratio and forward realized_mid_range
analysis.secondary_association: Spearman rank correlation between spread_state_ratio and forward absolute_close_return
analysis.quartile_diagnostic: within each symbol, compare mean forward realized_mid_range for top quartile versus bottom quartile of spread_state_ratio; quartiles are descriptive only and create no executable threshold
analysis.annual_diagnostic: pool all four symbols within each development year and compute primary Spearman association

predeclared_structure_screen.interpretation: MARKET_STATE_STRUCTURE_DETECTED authorizes only later human review of whether a separate predeclared strategy hypothesis is scientifically justified. It does not freeze a candidate, open validation, or authorize trading.
